description: This file defines interfaces related to log consistency protocols within the Orleans framework, including a protocol participant interface and a marker interface for protocol messages.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolParticipant
classes.description: Interface for grains participating in multi-cluster log-consistency protocols, providing lifecycle methods for activation and deactivation.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolMessage
classes.description: Marker interface to identify classes that represent protocol messages and should be serializable.

methods.name: PreActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called before the grain's activation logic executes, for preparatory actions.

methods.name: PostActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called after the grain's activation completes.

methods.name: DeactivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called after the grain's deactivation logic executes.
